## [1.8.0](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0) (2026-11-25)

### ✨ New Features

* Add edited lyric line review and restore controls ([94ea59e](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/commit/94ea59e7b18a0bfa2d01e986753176c67708ed5c))
* Add LRC export for displayed lyrics ([d2aee8a](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/commit/d2aee8a13fe504168fab90bd4add471984fd63a0))
* Support synced and unsynced local LRC files in LRCLIB lyrics ([f13f4d3](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/commit/f13f4d3c58770ed4cbaaa62fc16a3b8df509e24b))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Restore synced lyrics auto-return and tracking after scrolling ([5fd2ad6](https://github.com/Nich87/nich87-patches/commit/5fd2ad63e95106029790ad2e4be1333784ac33f8))

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Replaces Apple Music's font across views, Compose screens, and lyrics using imported .ttf/.otf/.ttc files or system fonts, with optional SF Pro Latin preservation and per-scope settings.

patches.name: LRCLIB lyrics
patches.description: Loads synced and unsynced local LRC files (per-song or auto-matched folder) and fetches lyrics from LRCLIB with per-song overrides, timing offsets, and a source indicator. Optionally generates pronunciation guides on-device.

patches.name: Library import, export and downloads
patches.description: Adds JSON library and playlist backups, additive import, and a native download action for the entire library.

patches.name: Liquid Glass bottom bar
patches.description: Adds live refractive glass to Apple Music's mini-player and bottom tabs, an animated selection lens, and a glass transition between the mini-player and Now Playing. Refraction requires Android 13 or newer.

patches.name: On-device vocal separation
patches.description: Adds a vocal and accompaniment mix slider to the lyrics screen. Supports stereo and Dolby Atmos PCM after a one-time model download.

patches.name: Repair Japanese library metadata
patches.description: Finds romanized library metadata and repairs selected songs using Japanese catalog data, preserving library entries and syncing changes to the account.

patches.name: Spaces local mute
patches.description: Locally mute specific speakers on the listener side in Twitter/X Spaces and replays (via Space profile popups or header mute sheet) without affecting other listeners. Compatible standalone or alongside Piko.
